objectives.note: Default literature-search.sh now quarantines unadjudicated docs entirely (task #835 feature, postdates plan); confirmed banner via --include-unverified and --read instead of the plan's literal grep command, which returns empty by design.

deviations.description: Confirm the change is visible to consumers, i.e. the [UNVERIFIED …] banner now appears
deviations.reason: literature-search.sh has a quarantine feature (task #835, postdates this plan) that excludes provenance_fidelity in {unverified_summary, unverified_no_baseline, unadjudicated} from default search output entirely -- the bare query in the plan's verification command now returns zero results (degraded search), so grep for UNVERIFIED finds nothing there. Verified visibility instead via `--include-unverified` (shows provenance_fidelity: unadjudicated per result) and `--read <chunk_id>` (shows the literal '[UNVERIFIED CONTENT - provenance_fidelity: unadjudicated]' banner). This is a stronger protection than the banner alone.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — verified via --include-unverified/--read since default search now quarantines unadjudicated docs entirely)*
